jobType.title: Job Type
jobType.description: Which job board segment to search.

resultsPerPage.title: Results Per Page
resultsPerPage.description: Listings to load per results page. Higher = fewer pagination round-trips.

maxListPages.title: Max Listing Pages
maxListPages.description: Cap on how many results pages to crawl while enumerating firms.

maxFirms.title: Max Firms
maxFirms.description: Cap on unique firms (and detail-page visits). 0 = no cap (all firms).

testMode.title: Test Mode
testMode.description: Crawl only 1 listing page and at most 10 firms. Use to verify the actor quickly.
